title: note v0.3 and SVG rows: the verified mapping (input data for scripts/audit_note_N1.py --note-rows)
how_built: Ten mapper chains, one per span (S1-S8 the note's lines; S9 F1b's text nodes; S10 F2's text nodes), each a mapper's row set, one adversarial check of it, and the mapper's revision. The routed task text carried the ten final sets but arrived truncated inside S4's first-round set, so S5-S10 were not in it; every chain's final set is read here from the chain's own scratch output (sha256 per file under 'provenance'). For S1-S4 the routed text is a reworded rendering of the same rows: the row counts and the per-status figure counts equal the routed summaries, and four distinctive rows were compared by value, status and the substance of their comments (S1 '1.5', S2 the smoke-run 'two', S3 'twice', S4 the MLP '.60'); the wording of comments differs. Rows are kept as the mappers wrote them, in matcher order, with 'span' and 'seq' added. One normalisation: the scratchpad's absolute path prefix is written '<scratchpad>'. A 'validation_note' is N1 final's addition, only on rows its validation flags, and says so. Scratch files are not committed; this file is the record of them. Round 5 (N1 final fixes, 2026-10-09): N1 final applied the final checker's findings 1-9 and the PI's N19 routing to named rows, each with a 'round5' record (the finding, why, and every changed field's previous value); added one row (S2#43, 'every fourth', placed after S2#32 in reading order); added structured 'correction', 'corrected_in_note', 'status_basis', 'validation_exempts' and 'validation_quote' fields where the ledger's section 10 says; reworded one span note (S3, redaction) and added 'span_note_annotations' beside eight others. The edit script is in scratch (not committed); the ledger's section 10 lists every changed row. Round 6 (N1 final fixes, round 2, 2026-10-09): N1 final applied the findings of the adversarial check of round 5 to named rows, each with a 'round6' record (the finding, why, and every changed field's previous value): exemptions set to the validator's whole failure message, five new ledger-status exemptions and one new locator-value exemption (S7#15), two locators, and the removal of a quotation from two round-5 change records; added two span-note annotations (S2, S7) that supersede round 5's on the π̂ gloss. The edit script is in scratch (not committed); the ledger's section 11 lists every changed row. Round 7 (N1 final fixes, round 3, 2026-10-09): N1 final applied the findings of the strict check of round 6 to named rows, each with a 'round7' record (the finding, why, and every changed field's previous value): fourteen locators name the ledger row whose status the row carries, three ledger_row fields name the comparison rows their locators name, two locators give the stored analyses' full paths, and two rows carry a status_basis. The edit script is in scratch (not committed); the ledger's section 12 lists every changed row.

schema.row_fields: span, seq; then the mapper's fields: note_file, note_line (S9/S10: the text-node index under the matcher's extraction, which joins text/tspan/title/desc content one node per line), text (S9 writes "'<unit>' in node '<node text>'"), kind (figure | not-figure), maps_to (ledger-row | item-raw | audit-raw-new | record | none), status (reproduced | log-only | not found | discrepant | computed-new | not run | n/a), ledger_row, locator, source_value, clause, cause, comment, not_figure_reason; validation_note (N1 final's, where present); round 5: correction ({kind: wording|precision|scope, text, whose, basis}), corrected_in_note ({locator, quote}), status_basis ({locator, quote}), validation_exempts (checks a validation_note explains), validation_quote (asserted on a cited line), round5 ({finding, why, changed: [{field, previous}]}); round 6: round6 ({finding, why, changed: [{field, previous}]}); validation_exempts maps a check to its whole failure message; round 7: round7 ({finding, why, changed: [{field, previous}]})
schema.status_rule: statuses are carried from the item raw (or the provisional ledger row) exactly, and the validator checks each against what the item raw gives (ledger 10a); a wording, scope or precision problem in the note's sentence is recorded in 'correction', never as a status (round 5)

(i) 'A forced phase runs two rounds under each label in alternation' fits e2a, f1 and e2d, but not PROPOSAL-k Stage 1, the fresh-session stage the note reports in link 3 (:88). That stage used F2 block order, [A, A, B, B] (PROPOSAL-k-echo-channel.md@bbc9ffe:201). (ii) 'One label delivers +d ... and the other −d' fits e2a and e2b. e2d delivered +axis against nothing (PROPOSAL-j-dose-escalation.md@bbc9ffe:96-98), and k1 used +/vehicle, as the note itself says at :88. In e2a, the 512-token encode tail collapsed the steering boundary to 0 on 270 of 1,894 archived generations (every free3-free5 round whose prefix plus segment exceeded 512 tokens). Those rounds were generated with the state live over the whole tail window, not the round-task span. rows.source_value: ours, trials run per stage: criterion arm 96 control, no injected; exploration arm 96 (48 injected / 48 control); greedy B2 48 per arm (24 injected / 24 control) [reproduced: artifact n, trial rows]
rows.comment: Added in this revision (checker's missed unit; the matcher does not extract the number word). 'Our tens' is the magnitude of our trials run per stage. Each count is two-digit (24, 48, 96; checked on the bbc9ffe artifacts: b2r_control_* n = 96, b2r_explore_* 48 injected / 48 control), so the magnitude itself reproduces. As the clause's contrast with '~800 injected and ~80 control' it falls under W5 (results/raw/2026-10-08_note-N2vi-source.md@09c3a8c:620, condition 4): a figure derived from the not-found n is cut with it, or stated with its premise and unit. If the sentence is restated rather than cut, the contrast is not uniform. Under the per-configuration reading, our criterion arm's 96 control trials per stage exceed ~80, so the control-side contrast fails for that arm; only the exploration arm (48) and the greedy run (24) sit below ~80 controls. On the injected side every arm that has injected trials (48, 24) is below ~800. Under the pooled-per-stage reading the premise gives 16000/1600 (results/raw/2026-10-08_note-N2vi-source.md@09c3a8c:30), and the contrast holds on both sides.
